_comment: Officer registers for the ship-captain layer. Chris's fiction: the naming conventions are his, set out in docs/setting.md under 'Names and titles'. The convention is title plus name; the title comes from rank or caste, the name morphology belongs to the species. TWO SHAPES, and which one a power gets is a fact about the species rather than a convenience: the Federation and the Krelath have a personal name AND a family name, so they carry 'given' and 'family' pools that combine; the Vraygon and the Zandrax have one name each, so they carry a written-out 'names' list. Editing any single entry changes exactly what it says and nothing else. Plain ASCII throughout, deliberately - one fewer thing to go wrong between the JSON, the browser console and Windows.
_titles: PLACEHOLDER, Fable's draft, not Chris's fiction. docs/setting.md records that the Krelath naval ladder, the Federation title ladder and the Zandrax ranks below Hivelord are all still to be written. Until they are, one title per power stands in. Overwrite the four 'title' fields freely; nothing else depends on their wording.

EAR.title: Capt.
EAR.register: Open the phone book. Real given names and real surnames, drawn from two pools and combined, so a Federation wardroom is never the same twice. Deliberately a WORLD phone book rather than an Earth one: Dominion planets carry near-equal standing, so Earth registers and Dominion registers stand side by side in one navy. The pools cross freely on purpose - Marvin Kaminski, Scott Ridley, Thomas Mbeki, Alice Cheng. A surname says where a family came from; a given name says where it has been since. This is the only one of the four registers drawn from life, and that is what makes the Federation read as a real polity rather than a science-fiction conceit.

KRE.title: Navarch
KRE.register: Hard consonants, two-part names, drawn from two pools and combined. Chris's worked examples are Archon Vezder and Supreme Leader Stratan Valdar; neither Valdar nor Vezder appears in either pool, because both belong to named characters. The titles above them are imperial and then revolutionary.

VRA.title: Warden
VRA.register: Chris's examples: Stalactar, Geos, Hydron. Mineral and geological roots with a classical ring, ending in -ar, -os, -on. A silicoid people name themselves for the rock they are, while their SHIPS are named for treasure - Goldspar, Sunthrone, Aurelian. The two registers should stay apart.

ZAN.title: Swarmlord
ZAN.register: Caste titles; clicking consonants and apostrophes. Chris's worked example is Hivelord Kzzx'xt, which is a rank above this one - the Zandrax ranks below Hivelord are still to be written, and 'Swarmlord' is standing in for whatever a one-ship commander turns out to be called. The fleet name is already Swarmfleet, so the vocabulary is at least in the right family.

_ascii: Plain ASCII only. Chris's ruling, 8 September 2026. A name needing a diacritic should be spelled the way it is spelled without one.
